'''Asset I-32''' was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. I-32 served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]],<ref name="State" /> but around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> I-32 was unexpectedly reassigned to a frontline posting and quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]] in battle, and the asset's [[Death/Legends|death]] prompted the Shroud to send [[Asset I-4]] to investigate.<ref name="State" />
